abstract: A series of 96 patients who were diagnosed with 120 ovarian neoplasms at surgery have been reviewed. Nine types of benign ovarian cysts were encountered. Benign cystic teratoma with an incidence of 30% was the commonest tumor. The majority of these were in the 20-30 year age range. The mean age of the patients with mucinous cyst adenoma and benign cystic teratoma was significantly less (P less than 0.05) than those with serous cyst adenoma. The incidence of ovarian malignancies of 8.3% was low, and none of the malignancies was bilateral. There was a high incidence of 8.3% of malignant change in benign cystic teratomas. Abdominal pain and swelling were the symptoms most frequently experienced in patients with benign ovarian neoplasms.
abstract_ja: 手術時に診断された120個の卵巣腫瘍を有する96例の患者をレビューした。良性卵巣嚢胞は9種類が認められた。良性嚢胞性奇形腫が30%の頻度で最も多い腫瘍であった。その大部分は20〜30歳の年齢層に集中していた。粘液性嚢胞腺腫および良性嚢胞性奇形腫の患者の平均年齢は、漿液性嚢胞腺腫の患者より有意に低かった（P<0.05）。卵巣悪性腫瘍の発生率は8.3%と低く、悪性腫瘍はいずれも両側性ではなかった。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の8.3%に悪性化が認められ、その発生率は高かった。良性卵巣腫瘍の患者で最も多く経験された症状は、腹痛と腹部の腫脹であった。
